title: Formal Abel relations for curves in characteristic $p$
summary: In this working paper, we report recent work studying the form of Abel relations in the (generalized) Jacobians of reduced plane curves over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p$ from a formal power series point of view. The ultimate goal (to be addressed in a subsequent paper) is to complete the work done in the author's PhD thesis from 1980 and to establish a general characteristic $p$ form of the converse of Abel's theorem discussed by Griffths and used in the Lie-Wirtinger theorem on double translation manifolds and the geometry of webs.
